name: split-button
title: SplitButton
description: Fluent 2's SplitButton: a main action joined to a menu of its variants, a Button and a chevron IconButton that opens a DropdownMenu (Base UI's Menu), in Button's primary, secondary, outline, subtle and transparent appearances and small, medium and large.
usage: Use SplitButton when one action is the usual choice and a few close variants should stay one click away: Run (statement under cursor) with Run selection and Explain in the menu, Export CSV with other formats. Put the action's label in children and its handler in onClick, and the menu's DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuLabel and DropdownMenuSeparator in menu; name the menu button with menuLabel. loading shows the action running while the menu stays usable. When there is no usual choice, use a DropdownMenu behind a plain Button; for unrelated actions, separate Buttons. The old variant prop (ghost is subtle) and sm/md/lg still work for one release.

props.name: menu
props.description: The menu's content: DropdownMenu items, groups, labels, separators.

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the menu button; say what it holds ("Run options").

props.name: appearance
props.description: Button appearance of both halves; the divider and the open menu button follow it.

props.name: size
props.description: Height of both halves, from size.control.*; the menu button is square.

props.name: variant
props.description: The old name of appearance; ghost maps to subtle. Kept for one release.

props.name: size (sm, md, lg)
props.description: The old size names, mapped to small, medium and large. Kept for one release.

props.name: loading
props.description: The main action is running: its Button shows loading (aria-busy); the menu stays usable.

props.name: align
props.description: How the menu lines up with the control.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the menu; defaultOpen and onOpenChange as DropdownMenu's.

slots.name: root
slots.description: role="group" joining the halves; data-slot="split-button", data-appearance, data-size.

slots.name: action
slots.description: The main action, a Button with square inner corners.

slots.name: menu-button
slots.description: The IconButton with Fluent's ChevronDown (aria-haspopup="menu"), with a divider on its inner edge; data-slot="dropdown-menu-trigger".

slots.name: menu
slots.description: DropdownMenu's popup (role="menu") in a portal, aligned to the end of the control.

states.name: hover
states.description: Each half takes its Button appearance's hover look.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Each half shows Fluent's double ring and is lifted above the other half so the ring is never covered.

states.name: open
states.description: While the menu is open the menu button keeps its pressed look.

states.name: loading
states.description: The main action ignores clicks and sets aria-busy while it runs.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Both halves in Fluent's disabled fill and text, ignoring interaction.

accessibility: The control is a role="group" of two buttons, each in the tab order: the action, named by its label, and the menu button, named by menuLabel, with aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded.
Enter or Space on the action runs it; on the menu button, Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens the menu with the first item highlighted; Escape closes it and returns focus to the menu button.
The menu follows DropdownMenu: arrows, Home, End and typing move, Enter chooses; a press outside closes it.
loading keeps the action focusable and sets aria-busy; the divider is a border colour, and the halves are separate buttons, so the split does not rest on colour alone.
The menu takes the control's theme and density and sits at z.popover.
